title: Never Caught
sentences: In 1888, a killer terrified London, and nobody knows who he was.
Five women were murdered in and around Whitechapel, in the East End.
Their names were Mary Ann Nichols, Annie Chapman, Elizabeth Stride, Catherine Eddowes and Mary Jane Kelly.
They were real women, most living in deep poverty.
The name Jack the Ripper came from a letter many historians think was a hoax.
More than a hundred suspects have been named.
Some historians doubt all five were killed by the same man.
